chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Indeed, these hearts become weary/tired just as the bodies become weary/tired, so seek for them the rare/beautiful sayings of wisdom.

key_terms.الْقُلُوبَ: hearts (plural of qalb, referring to the spiritual center)
key_terms.طَرَائِفَ: rare, exquisite, or beautiful sayings/things (plural of tarīf)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to seek 'ṭarā’if al-ḥikmah' for the heart?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) draws a profound physiological analogy, noting that just as the body tires of repetitive food, the heart grows weary of monotonous spiritual nourishment. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights the necessity of diversifying one's engagement with wisdom (hikmah) to maintain spiritual vitality and prevent stagnation. This teaching encourages seekers to actively pursue varied and profound insights to keep the soul engaged and refreshed.
